title: Capybara Fairy Serpent
description: A brown capybara with delicate translucent wings covered in banknotes and flowers stands at the center of a swirling vortex. It has a red heart on its chest, holds a white snake in its paw, and is surrounded by floating colorful letters, corn cobs, and glowing hearts against a deep purple spiral background.
prompt: A detailed surreal painting of a friendly brown capybara standing in the center of a swirling rainbow vortex. The capybara has large translucent fairy wings made of banknotes and flowers, a bright red heart on its chest, and is gently holding a white snake. Colorful letters, golden corn cobs, and small hearts float around it. Deep purple background with spiral motion, vibrant and whimsical atmosphere.
